'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of North Gaza]], [[Gaza famine]]
****The [[United States]]-funded [[Famine Early Warning Systems Network]] removes a report estimating that [[Food security|food insecurity]] conditions in [[North Gaza Governorate|northern Gaza]] have surpassed the highest [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification|IPC]] [[Famine|famine thresholds]], after the [[List of ambassadors of the United States to Israel|United States envoy to Israel]] criticized the report's methodology as "irresponsible" for "outdated" and "inflated" estimates of the civilian population of Gaza. [https://archive.is/0LFkL (''FEWS NET'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/us-backed-monitor-takes-down-report-alleging-north-gaza-famine-after-objections/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
***[[Jubaland crisis]]
****The [[federal government of Somalia]] imposes a flight ban on [[Jubaland]], including all flights to and from Jubaland, particularly affecting the cities of [[Kismayo]] and [[Doolow]]. The flight ban was initiated amid ongoing political tensions and military engagements after [[Jubaland Dervish Force|Jubaland forces]] reportedly defeated [[Somali Armed Forces]] in several locations, including [[Battle of Ras Kamboni (2024)|Ras Kamboni]], Kulbiyow, and Dolow. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-fgs-s-aerial-lockdown-on-jubaland-sparks-new-conflict-strands-travelers (Garowe Online)] [https://thesomalidigest.com/fgs-imposes-flight-ban-on-jubaland-amid-military-setbacks/ (''The Somali Digest'')] [https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia/99577/somalia-bans-flights-to-jubaland-as-tensions-escalate (''The Eastleigh Voice'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]], [[Ukrainian energy crisis]]
***A series of [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[ballistic missile]] and [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] target critical [[Energy in Ukraine|energy infrastructure]] in cities across in [[Ukraine]], killing at least two people, injuring 20 others, and causing widespread [[Rolling blackout|emergency blackouts]]. [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] condemns [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] for the "inhumane" attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure. [https://kyivindependent.com/russia-terrorizes-ukraine-with-mass-missile-drone-attack-on-christmas-morning/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/25/russia-christmas-day-attack-ukraine-energy-system (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2024/1225/1488087-ukraine-russia/ (RTÉ)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2024 famine in Sudan]]
***The [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification|IPC Famine Review Committee]] determines the presence of [[famine]] in five areas in [[Darfur]] and [[South Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], and estimates that five more areas will face famine by May 2025 due to [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|ongoing conflict]] and blocked aid distribution. [https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cr567y3117vo (BBC News Hausa)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[Syria]]'s [[First Syrian transitional government|new government]] says that fourteen of its troops were killed and 10 others were injured in clashes with [[Bashar al-Assad|Assad regime]] loyalists in [[Tartus Governorate]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0ew5g3vzreo (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-forces-suffer-14-fatalities-tartous-clashes-2024-12-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ethiopian civil conflict (2018–present)|Ethiopian civil conflict]]
**[[Ethiopia]]n [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|military forces]] close the [[Ethiopia–Somalia border|country's border]] with [[Somalia]] following ongoing heavy fighting in rural areas of [[Harshin]], [[Fafan Zone]], between Ethiopia's Somali regional forces and local clan militias after the killing of a local security chief and his bodyguards. Hundreds of people, including children, flee from their homes. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Dec/199528/ethiopian_military_closes_border_with_somaliland_as_fighting_erupts_in_somali_region.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/tensions-soar-along-ethiopia-somaliland-border-as-clashes-resume/ (''Somali Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243]]
**An [[Azerbaijan Airlines]] [[Embraer 190]] aircraft carrying 67 passengers from [[Baku]], [[Azerbaijan]], to [[Grozny]], [[Russia]], crashes while being diverted to [[Aktau]], [[Kazakhstan]], killing 38 people and injuring 29 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/25/passenger-plane-crashes-in-kazakhstan-emergencies-ministry (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.npr.org/2024/12/25/g-s1-39977/azerbaijan-airlines-passenger-jet-crashes (NPR)]
**[[President of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijan President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] instructs the [[Government of Azerbaijan|government]] to launch a criminal investigation into the crash. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/26/azerbaijani-president-ilham-aliyev-launches-criminal-probe-into-azerbaijan-airlines-plane- (Euronews)]
*[[2024 Estlink 2 incident]]
**[[High-voltage direct current|HVDC]] [[submarine power cable]] [[Estlink#Estlink 2|Estlink 2]], which connects the [[Electrical grid|power grids]] of [[Estonia]] and [[Finland]], suffers an unexplained outage with [[Prime Minister of Finland|Finnish Prime Minister]] [[Petteri Orpo]] stating that an investigation into the incident is underway. [https://apnews.com/article/finland-estonia-cable-outage-baltic-estlink2-orpo-a904d86cce60f2bc76866bcb53051d3e (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*More than 1,500 inmates [[prison escape|escape from a prison]] in [[Maputo]], [[Mozambique]], after knocking down a wall during a [[prison riot|riot]]. At least 33 people are killed and 15 others are injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cnv36qrnejno (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/25/jailbreak-amid-mozambique-protests-sees-1500-prisoners-escape-33-killed (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syria]]n authorities impose a [[curfew]] from 6 pm to 8 am in [[Homs]] following a series of protests by [[Alawites|Alawite]] and [[Shia Islam|Shi'ite Muslim]] minority groups. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-police-impose-curfew-homs-after-unrest-2024-12-25/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Judicial system of Turkey|Turkish court]] sentences the owner and architect of the [[Grand Isias Hotel]] in [[Adıyaman]] to more than 18 years in prison for [[negligent homicide]] after 72 people died when the hotel collapsed in the [[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquakes|2023 earthquakes]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-jails-owner-of-hotel-that-collapsed-during-2023-quake/a-71157883 (DW)]
